Individuals Quit Corporate Jobs for New Careers and Travel

Two personal accounts were reported about leaving demanding corporate positions. One individual worked 12‑hour days in a corporate role they liked, then quit to become a waitress. The other individual quit their job to travel across ten countries in 99 days, saying they love adventure. Both stories were published by Business Insider and Metro (UK). No additional verification or follow‑up was provided in the coverage.
